summary: Verified all 5 acceptance criteria against the unit-test work package (work/WP-003.md).
Build check: PHPStan level 5 reports 0 errors across 142 files.
Test run: 81/81 tests pass (60 pre-existing + 21 new), 0 failures, 0 regressions.

ComicsFilterTest (13 tests): covers setSearchText(), empty-string gate (plain and whitespace-only), reset() clearing searchText, OR-logic label/synopsis matching, case-insensitivity, substring matching, and no-match exclusion — all AC-1 requirements confirmed.

PaginationRenderingTest (8 tests): covers page clamping (beyond-last and zero/negative), 0-item no-output, exactly-20-item no-output, 21-item renders pagination, multi-page ellipsis, and accessibility attributes (aria-disabled, tabindex=-1, href='#') on disabled Previous/Next links — all AC-2 requirements confirmed.
TestableComicsFilter correctly exposes protected isMatch() and reset() via thin public wrappers. TestableDetailedListPage uses output buffering to capture renderPagination() HTML — pattern is clean.

Pre-existing issues (not introduced by WP-004): 1 PHPUnit deprecation from legacy phpunit.xml attributes (convertErrorsToExceptions/Notices/Warnings deprecated in PHPUnit 12); 1 Linux-only skipped test (FetchCacheTests::testPutThrowsOnWriteFailure). Neither affects test pass/fail outcome.

Edge-case analysis: mb_stripos() used in isMatch() is not regex-based, so special characters in search terms are safe. BasePage constructor takes no arguments so TestableDetailedListPage instantiates cleanly.

comments.note: TestableComicsFilter and TestableDetailedListPage follow the established TestClasses pattern cleanly. The ob_start/ob_get_clean approach in TestableDetailedListPage is idiomatic for PHP output-buffer methods.

Pre-existing phpunit.xml config deprecation (convertErrorsToExceptions/Notices/Warnings): These attributes are deprecated in PHPUnit 12. Not introduced by this WP. Recommend removing them in a housekeeping WP — PHPUnit 12 handles error/warning-to-exception conversion natively.

ComicsFilterTest::makeComic() stubs isArchived(), isCompleted(), and isActive() alongside getLabel() and getSynopsis(). This is defensive — isMatch() checks status conditions first, so the stubs ensure status checks do not interfere with search-text tests. Good practice.

No test covers searchText containing multibyte or special regex characters (e.g., accented characters, parentheses). mb_stripos() handles these safely, but a dedicated test would document the behaviour explicitly. Consider adding in a future test-enhancement pass.

summary: Reviewed 4 files: tests/TestClasses/TestableComicsFilter.php, tests/TestClasses/TestableDetailedListPage.php, tests/TestSuites/ComicsFilterTest.php, tests/TestSuites/PaginationRenderingTest.php.
All files carry declare(strict_types=1), use final classes, and follow the established TestClasses proxy pattern — fully consistent with project conventions.

ComicsFilterTest: 13 well-structured tests with section comments. Uses createStub() with isArchived/isCompleted/isActive stubs to prevent status-guard interference with search-text logic — correct defensive practice. Fluent return value (testSetSearchTextReturnsSelf) is verified, which is important for the project's fluent-API contract.

PaginationRenderingTest: 8 boundary tests cover the full acceptance-criteria surface including WP-002 accessibility attributes. range() usage for fixture data is clean and avoids external dependencies.

One minor non-blocking observation: TestableDetailedListPage uses raw ob_start()/ob_get_clean() while production DetailedListPage uses the project's AppUtils\OutputBuffering helper. The (string) cast handles the false return safely, but using OutputBuffering would be more consistent with project patterns.

One pre-existing non-blocking observation: production DetailedListPage::_render() hardcodes 20 items-per-page; the test mirrors it with ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 20. Extracting this to a class constant would eliminate future drift — but this is a pre-existing issue, not introduced by this WP.
No blocking issues. Code is clean, maintainable, and correctly validates all 5 acceptance criteria.

comments.note: TestableDetailedListPage uses raw ob_start()/ob_get_clean() while production DetailedListPage already imports and uses AppUtils\OutputBuffering. The (string) cast on ob_get_clean() handles the false return safely, but future test helpers in TestClasses should prefer OutputBuffering::start() / OutputBuffering::get() for consistency with project patterns.

PaginationRenderingTest::ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 20 mirrors a magic number hardcoded in DetailedListPage::_render() ('new ArrayPagination($comics, 20, ...)'). Promoting this to a public class constant (e.g., DetailedListPage::ITEMS_PER_PAGE) would make the test self-documenting and eliminate drift risk. Pre-existing issue, not introduced by this WP.

No test for multibyte or special-character search terms (e.g., accented characters). mb_stripos() handles these correctly, but a dedicated test would document the behaviour explicitly. Appropriately deferred by QA agent. Consider adding in a future test-hygiene pass.
